description: A site's design tokens read from computed styles in a real browser: colours by role with contrast ratios, the dark theme colours when the site has one, the type scale, corner radius and button styling, how panels, the header bar and panel titles are drawn, plus ready-made CSS, Tailwind and shadcn/ui stylesheets. Values defined through CSS variables come back resolved to the hex actually painted. To recreate how a site looks rather than only its tokens, take a screenshot of the page too.

domain.description: The domain to read, e.g. stripe.com, using its homepage. Send this or url.

maxAge.description: Accept a stored result no older than this many milliseconds. 0 reads fresh.

url.description: One page to read instead of the homepage, e.g. https://stripe.com/pricing.

name: styleguide
